step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard diagram illustrates a machine learning pipeline at econda divided into three visual phases: Training, Storage, and Inference. In the Training phase, a Lambda function triggers a SageMaker pre-processing job which fetches data from the econda API (UserCompanyAPI) bi-directionally. After pre-processing, it triggers a second SageMaker training job on GPU instances. Secrets Manager is present in the training section. The trained model is uploaded to S3 in the Storage section (which also contains ECR for container images). In the Inference phase, an S3 event triggers a second Lambda function to create/update an ECS service. The Personalization Service ARP (UserCompanyInternalPlatform) communicates bi-directionally with the ECS service for real-time inference requests and responses.
